category: a state made at a human's pace
windowGives: nothing the agent lacks: the human's state on the screen (W1 has it too)
symptom: I searched for "lamp" and the results show products that do not match, like Ladder and Lantern.
cause: Search starts a request for every change of the text and writes whichever answer arrives last; a shorter query matches more products and the API answers it later, so the answer for "la" overwrites the one for "lamp". The effect has no guard against a stale answer.
